narrative: The morning's leaf on the knee, the fire on the ink. The verse is clear. The cups are still on the oak. No pen in the hand. Mid-leaf. The sentence about the brake. Nothing added in the margin. A damp sleeve at the edge of the settle. The foot. The question, the last sentence, then bare paper that the fire makes look almost written on, and is not.
